sampleWarning: The mechanism was proposed after inspecting the prior final-test inventory loss; validation and test labels are retained for chronology but are not untouched holdouts.

strategyDefinition.entryPolicy: frozen prior GEX/wall entry gate and aggregation parameters
strategyDefinition.pairExit: first pair equal long/short quantities when their open-price net PnL is positive; otherwise spend prior realized take-profit credit once to close aged inventory only when absolute net exposure falls
strategyDefinition.stagedExit: reduce a trained fraction of remaining lot quantity at deterministic age stages before mandatory expiry
strategyDefinition.sameBarRule: a side that risk-exits cannot reopen on the same candle

decision.rule: 复用历史不能授权仿真交易；未来新增的点时样本还必须满足 BTC/ETH 验证、测试及成本压力收益均为正，零清算且最差回撤不超过 2%。
